steps.title: Look at the two questions.
steps.prompt: What is different about the second question?
options: A question word comes before do.
steps.answer: A question word comes before do.
steps.why: A Wh- word goes first, then the same do / does question follows.
steps.html:
Do you live in the centre? — Yes, I do.

Where do you live? — In the centre.

steps.title: Wh- questions
steps.html:
Question wordAsks aboutExample
Whata thingWhat do you do?
Wherea placeWhere does she work?
When / What timea timeWhat time do you start?
Whya reasonWhy do you like it?
Whoa personWho do you work with?
How oftenfrequencyHow often do you travel?
How longa length of timeHow long does it take?

The order is always: Wh- word + do/does + person + verb.

The main verb stays in the base form: Where does he work?

The answer is not yes or no — it is information.
